bio: Iristeia was raised in the Sacriat to be the ultimate war cleric: an Exarch-General and their personal imperial enforcer. But, Iristeia was too good at it. She led from the front, and her heroism soon earned her an Angel’s wings… putting her in charge of those who had once sought to control her.
